next.reason: §2023:14.9.51.4 GR9 restates 'the information in the area referenced by identifier-1 is available ... even though the information in the area referenced by record-name-1 is not available except as specified by the SAME RECORD AREA clause', with §2023:14.9.51.4 GR4 the SAME RECORD AREA part. Its proviso excludes an identifier-1 within the file's records, which 1985 SR VII.4.7.3-1 refused ('must not refer to the same storage area'); 'successful' versus 'complete' changes nothing, since no WRITE rule alters identifier-1 and a failed WRITE leaves the record area unaffected (§2023:14.9.51.4 GR15, 1985 GR8 and GR13).
